youtube.title: Why Your Fingers Wrinkle In Water 🛁 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your fingers wrinkle in water on purpose.

Finger wrinkling is controlled by your nerves: fingers with a cut nerve don't wrinkle. Blood vessels under the skin shrink, and one study found wrinkled fingers handle wet objects faster, like tyre tread in the rain.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
